q1.sampleAnswer: Because he thought he didn’t have time to read, and there always seemed to be something to keep him busy.

keyPoints.descZh: 觉得没有时间读书，总有事情忙
examples: he didn’t have time to read

q1.rubricZh: 要点：觉得没时间读书，总有别的事情要忙。
q1.explanationZh: 第一段说大学毕业后，作者总说“没时间”读书，因为好像总有事情要忙。

evidence.quote: After college, I just “didn’t have time” to read.

q2.sampleAnswer: Because a quote from Mark Twain made him feel ashamed and then decide to start reading again.

keyPoints.descZh: 马克·吐温的话让他感到羞愧，于是决定重新开始读书
examples: a quote from Mark Twain made him feel ashamed and decide to start reading again

q2.rubricZh: 要点：马克·吐温的一句话让他羞愧，因此决定重新读书。
q2.explanationZh: 第二、三段说他看到马克·吐温的话，一阵羞愧，于是决定重新开始读书。

evidence.quote: Suddenly, a wave of shame hit me.
I decided I had to start reading again.

q3.explanationZh: 第四段第一句说他先读的是荷马的古代故事。

q4.sampleAnswer: His vocabulary has grown richer. His conversations have become more thoughtful. He has developed an ability to comment on social values and historical events. He has developed an ability to see life and people more deeply. He has rethought what it means to be human.

keyPoints.descZh: 词汇更丰富、谈话更有深度、更能评论社会价值和历史事件
examples: His conversations have become more thoughtful.

keyPoints.descZh: 更深入地看待生活和人，重新思考做人的意义
examples: He has developed an ability to see life and people more deeply.
He has rethought what it means to be human.

q4.rubricZh: 要点：两方面——词汇、谈话、评论能力的提升；对生活与人的更深理解。
q4.explanationZh: 第五段列出了变化：词汇更丰富，谈话更有深度，能更好地评论社会，也更深刻地看待生活和人。

q5.sampleAnswer: He feels excited that there is always more to read.

keyPoints.descZh: 感到兴奋，因为总有更多书可读
examples: there is always more to read

q5.rubricZh: 要点：兴奋，因为总有另一本书可读。
q5.explanationZh: 最后一段说他也许读不完，但“总有另一本书可读”这个想法让他兴奋。

evidence.quote: But the idea that there’s always another book to read

q6.sampleAnswer: I feel the same as the author did. I would like to read a bit more of these classics in my spare time to find out what makes them great books. (Answers may vary.)

keyPoints.descZh: 表明自己对这句话的看法
examples: I feel the same as the author did.

keyPoints.descZh: 说出合理的理由或打算
examples: I would like to read a bit more of these classics in my spare time to find out what makes them great books.

q6.rubricZh: 开放题：只要观点明确、理由合理即可。
q6.explanationZh: 这是开放题。先说你同意还是不同意这句话，再写一个理由，例如想读经典、想知道它们好在哪里。

evidence.quote: A classic is a book which people praise and don’t read.
